question: Should the session-cost status feature use a bounded or maintained aggregate before merge, accept full transcript scans in default status, or wait for broader session usage storage work?
rationale: The requested feature is useful and aligned, but the active PR’s data-source choice changes the default status responsiveness tradeoff; that is a maintainer product/architecture decision rather than a routine bug fix.

options.title: Require bounded aggregate
options.body: Ask the active PR to use a bounded read, cached aggregate, or maintained session aggregate so default `/status` and `openclaw status` stay fast.

options.title: Accept exact full scans
options.body: Allow full transcript scans for exact session cost, accepting possible stalls for long-running sessions as an intentional tradeoff.

options.title: Wait for storage work
options.body: Keep this issue open until broader session usage aggregation work can provide a canonical stored cost source.

recommendation.title: Require bounded aggregate
recommendation.body: Ask the active PR to use a bounded read, cached aggregate, or maintained session aggregate so default `/status` and `openclaw status` stay fast.

likelyOwner.reason: Current line blame and recent status/session metadata history make steipete the best available owner for the status fast-path tradeoff.
